claim: Search params are first-class application state and the router should own their validation schema, otherwise schemas fragment across hooks and utilities.
quote: Search params have been historically treated like second-class state ... Writing search params is where it falls apart ... Constraint is what makes coordination possible.

claim: TanStack Router validates search params per route with a schema, stores JSON-serializable structures (arrays/nested objects), and re-renders only components reading the changed param.
quote: You can store any JSON-serializable data structure in your search params and it will be parsed and serialized as JSON, which is a huge improvement over URLSearchParams which has limited support for array-like structures and nested data.

claim: Route loaders and TanStack Query compose rather than compete: the loader calls ensureQueryData() and the component reads the same cache via useSuspenseQuery().
quote: designed to be a perfect coordinator for external data fetching and caching libraries

claim: beforeLoad plus router context is the auth-guard mechanism; throwing redirect() sends unauthenticated users to login, and a parent route's beforeLoad runs before all children, guarding a whole subtree.
quote: the beforeLoad function for a route is called before any of its child routes' beforeLoad functions

claim: autoCodeSplitting in the Vite plugin automatically splits routes into critical (loader, params, validation) and non-critical (components) chunks; it requires a supported bundler, not just the CLI.
quote: This is the easiest and most powerful way to code split your route files.

claim: React Router declarative mode has no loader, action, useLoaderData or useNavigation; data/framework mode adds them, and framework mode requires the Vite plugin plus typegen for type-safe params and loaderData.
quote: Framework - Wraps Data Mode with a Vite plugin for type-safe APIs and code splitting

claim: React Router v8 shipped June 2026, ESM-only, requiring Node 22+/React 19+/Vite 7+, on a new yearly-major cadence under open governance.
quote: All v7 future flags are now the default (Middleware, Vite env API, Split Route Modules, etc.) - ESM-only - New baselines: node 22+, React 19+, Vite 7+

claim: TanStack Router repository, star count and activity as of July 2026.
quote: A client-first, server-capable, fully type-safe router and full-stack framework for the web (React and more).

claim: TanStack Query replaces the server-state portion of a global store, leaving only genuinely global client state for Redux/Zustand.
quote: Does TanStack Query replace Redux, MobX or other global state managers?

claim: React Router remains the safer default for most React teams in 2026 (ecosystem, migration friction), while TanStack Router suits client-heavy SPAs, admin panels and search-driven UIs where the URL carries rich state.
quote: React Router v7 is the safer default for most React teams in 2026. It has the biggest ecosystem, the least migration friction ... TanStack Router is well-suited to client-heavy SPAs, dashboards, admin panels, internal tools, and search-driven UIs where the URL carries rich application state.

claim: Community counterpoint: the read story for search params is strong, but writes and lifecycle are low-level and teams build a helper layer on top.
